english.title: Fail to surrender intoxicating liquor to constable

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: CONFISCATION OF ALCOHOL YOUNG PERSONS ACT 1997

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) failed without reasonable excuse to comply with a requirement imposed on you by a constable under section 1(1) of the Confiscation of Alcohol (Young Persons) Act 1997 to

(A)_[surrender what was, or was reasonably suspected by the constable to be, intoxicating liquor or a container for such liquor in your possession]_
(B)_[state your name and address]_
(C)_[surrender what was, or was reasonably suspected by the constable to be, intoxicating liquor or a container for such liquor in your possession and to state your name and address]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 1(3) of the Confiscation of Alcohol (Young Persons) Act 1997.

english.notes:
(i) As amended by Section 29 of the Criminal Justice and Police Act 2001.

other.powersofarrest: Section 1(5) provides that a constable may arrest without warrant a person who fails to comply with a requirement under section 1(1) to surrender suspected liquor and give his name and address.
other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level two on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
